body.x: Dementor introduced its app "Mommaeat" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.
This app connects local markets and the people who live around it. The residents can receive the items they buy easily, and the local markets get to promote their shops and items.

Currently, this service is available for free, and the shops that can use this service are markets, restaurants, and flower shops. The company plans to make it available for more types of shops and all over Korea.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
